items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: 25-piece band and I did the History of Jazz, the ragtime. They said, "Why do we have to go back so far?" I said, "Well, I'm going to do the History of Jazz." He thought it was something else, you know. So we were the first in the Philharmonic as a jazz unit.
